text_block_list.text:
One day, while passing by the training 
track, I noticed an exchange unfolding 
between two Umamusume a short distance 
away――

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—That is enough. Any further training is 
utterly pointless.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Pointless?! How could that be?! If I don't 
train harder, thenââ

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Even at the cost of injuring your legs?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Cast aside your impatience regarding 
your debut for now. Make absolutely sure 
that leg is examined by a proper 
professional.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your training can wait until after that. 
—I will definitely hear you out.

Saying that, the fired-up Umamusume bowed 
politely and took her leave.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. Guiding them is the natural duty 
of none other than myself, the 'Empress.' 
It is not a sideshow.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...For the sake of the Umamusume you 
guide, I shall answer just once. The 
answer is no.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Each of them has their own dream to aim 
for... and ground they simply refuse to 
give up.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Only by observing every detail thoroughly 
can one truly begin to guide them.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Adaptability. Without mastering it, how 
could one claim to be "Empress"――

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...We're done talking. You should hurry up 
and head back too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Insolent fool. To whom do you think you 
are spouting such nonsense?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As the Empress, if I cannot face each and 
every one of them directly, how could I 
ever hope to guide them?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will not tolerate such disrespect a 
second time. That goes for you, 
tooâwatch who you are speaking to, and 
choose your words wisely.
